summary:
Senior TA Reporting & Analytics Specialist with 8+ years of experience in Talent
Acquisition MIS, HR analytics, dashboarding, and data automation across large-scale
operations. Proven expertise in digitizing hiring data, building TA dashboards, multi-
dimensional analysis, and stakeholder reporting for senior HR leadership. Strong
background in data extraction, cleansing, dashboard visualization, and delivering
actionable hiring insights to enable data-driven workforce decisions. Advanced skills in
Excel automation, reporting frameworks, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(TA Analytics→HR Analytics(100%), Data Cleansing→Data Cleaning(100%), Region→RegMon(83%), HR analytics→HR Analytics(100%), hiring→Recruitment(100%)...)

bullets: Manage onboarding and hiring reports to ensure accurate and timely tracking of new hires across India.
Digitized and automated hiring MIS datasets to improve reporting accuracy and turnaround time.
Delivered leadership dashboards for HR stakeholders highlighting hiring funnel metrics, demand vs fulfilment, and recruiter productivity.
Performed multi-dimensional hiring analysis (LOB, region, recruiter, source, time-to- fill).
Provided actionable hiring insights to TA leadership to support workforce planning decisions.
Managed end-to-end MIS lifecycle: data extraction, cleansing, transformation, visualization, and reporting.
Supported TA teams with ad-hoc reports, hiring statistics, and analytics requirements.
Monitored referral payouts, onboarding reports, and joining trends to ensure process compliance.
Consolidate recruiter performance and activity metrics at a pan-India level.
Track and maintain hiring demands for multiple departments.
Oversee reporting related to employee joining and referral bonus payouts.
Conducted root cause analysis (RCA) to identify operational gaps and recommend corrective actions.
Developed and maintained quality management systems.
Streamlined business processes to reduce operational costs.
Delivered actionable insights and recommendations to improve business performance.

jobs.company: Identified bottlenecks in distribution and supply chain processes.
bullets: Analyzed business performance drivers and presented insights to senior management.
Prepared daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports across regions and channels.
Managed sales pipeline tracking for Digital and E-Commerce marketing.
Managed end-to-end MIS and reporting for large-scale operations, including HR, workforce and HR performance analytics.
Led MIS operations and managed a team of 12 MIS executives across Pune and Mumbai.
Gathered business requirements through stakeholder interviews, surveys, and workshops.
Analyzed data to identify trends and support strategic decision-making for HR and Operation.
Created KPI dashboards, APRs, invoices, YTD, hygiene, and schedule adherence reports.
Supported TA teams with ad-hoc reports, hiring statistics, and analytics requirements.
Improved processes through business process mapping and automation.
Coordinated with IT teams for MIS solution development and implementation.
Identified project risks and implemented mitigation strategies.
